raw_segments.text: Moving the lamp as the man moved, I made out that he was substantially dressed but roughly
like a voyager by sea, that he had long iron-gray hair, that his age was about sixty, that he
was a muscular man, strong on his legs, and that he was browned and hardened by exposure
As he ascended the last stair or two, and the light of my lamp included us both, I saw,
with a stupid kind of amazement, that he was holding out both his hands to me.
